"""Regression tests for the SDN controller layer of netsim."""

import subprocess
import sys

from netsim.net import Mininet
from netsim.sdn_controller import (FlowRule, FlowTable, ProactiveController,
                                   ReactiveController, SDNController,
                                   attach_controller)
from netsim.topo import LinearTopo, RingTopo, TreeTopo


def test_flow_rule_matching_and_stats():
    rule = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1", "in_port": 1},
                    [{"type": "output", "port": 2}], priority=200)
    assert rule.priority == 200 and rule.out_ports == [2]
    assert rule.matches({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1", "in_port": 1, "proto": 6})
    assert not rule.matches({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2", "in_port": 1})
    assert not rule.matches({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"})
    assert rule.packet_count == 0 and rule.byte_count == 0
    rule.apply(1500)
    rule.apply(500)
    assert rule.packet_count == 2 and rule.byte_count == 2000
    # a wildcard field matches anything
    wild = FlowRule({"dst_ip": None}, [])
    assert wild.matches({"dst_ip": "anything"}) and wild.matches({})


def test_flow_rule_timeouts():
    permanent = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, [])
    assert not permanent.is_expired(1e9, 0.0)
    idle = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, [], idle_timeout=10.0)
    assert idle.is_expired(15.0, 0.0)
    assert not idle.is_expired(15.0, 12.0)
    hard = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, [], hard_timeout=5.0,
                    install_time=0.0)
    assert hard.is_expired(6.0, 6.0)


def test_flow_table_capacity_lookup_and_eviction():
    t = FlowTable("s1", capacity=2)
    r1 = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, [{"type": "output", "port": 1}])
    r2 = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}, [{"type": "output", "port": 2}],
                  priority=50)
    assert t.install(r1) is True and t.install(r2) is True
    assert t.size() == 2 and t.utilization() == 1.0
    assert t.install(FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.3"}, [])) is False
    assert t.size() == 2
    # re-installing an existing match replaces it instead of overflowing
    assert t.install(FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, [], priority=300)) is True
    assert t.size() == 2 and t.lookup({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}).priority == 300
    assert t.lookup({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.9"}) is None
    assert [s[1] for s in t.stats()] == [0, 0]
    assert t.remove({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}) is r2
    assert t.remove({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}) is None
    t.clear()
    assert t.size() == 0


def test_flow_table_evicts_only_idle_rules():
    t = FlowTable("s1")
    last_matched = {}
    for i in range(20):
        rule = FlowRule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.%d" % (i + 1)}, [],
                        idle_timeout=10.0)
        t.install(rule)
        last_matched[rule] = 0.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 12.0
    assert t.size() == 20
    assert t.evict_expired(15.0, last_matched) == 10
    assert t.size() == 10
    # a second sweep at the same instant finds nothing more
    assert t.evict_expired(15.0, last_matched) == 0


def test_topology_discovery_and_dijkstra():
    net = Mininet(topo=TreeTopo(depth=2, fanout=3, bw=1000, delay=1.0))
    net.start()
    ctrl = SDNController("c0")
    attach_controller(net, ctrl)
    assert sorted(ctrl.switches) == ["s1", "s2", "s3", "s4"]
    assert len(ctrl.hosts) == 9 and ctrl.hosts["h1"] == "10.0.0.1"
    assert all(isinstance(t, FlowTable) for t in ctrl.flow_tables.values())
    assert ctrl.compute_path("h1", "h2") == ["h1", "s2", "h2"]
    assert ctrl.compute_path("h1", "h4") == ["h1", "s2", "s1", "s3", "h4"]
    assert ctrl.compute_path("h1", "h1") == ["h1"]
    assert ctrl.compute_path("h1", "nope") == []
    assert len(ctrl.compute_all_paths()) == 72
    # a partitioned graph yields an empty path, not an exception
    ctrl.remove_link("s1", "s2")
    assert ctrl.compute_path("h1", "h4") == []


def test_install_path_rules_uses_real_ports():
    net = Mininet(topo=LinearTopo(k=3, bw=1000, delay=1.0))
    net.start()
    ctrl = SDNController("c0")
    attach_controller(net, ctrl)
    path = ctrl.compute_path("h1", "h3")
    assert path == ["h1", "s1", "s2", "s3", "h3"]
    assert ctrl.install_path_rules(path, "10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.3") == 3
    assert ctrl.total_rules_installed() == 3
    rule = ctrl.flow_tables["s1"].lookup({"src_ip": "10.0.0.1",
                                          "dst_ip": "10.0.0.3"})
    assert rule is not None
    assert rule.out_ports == [net["s1"].portTo("s2")]
    # re-installing the same flow does not double count
    ctrl.install_path_rules(path, "10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.3")
    assert ctrl.total_rules_installed() == 3
    assert ctrl.remove_path_rules(path, "10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.3") == 3
    assert ctrl.total_rules_installed() == 0


def test_proactive_install_on_tree():
    net = Mininet(topo=TreeTopo(depth=2, fanout=3, bw=1000, delay=1.0))
    net.start()
    ctrl = ProactiveController("c0", rule_install_time_ms=0.1)
    attach_controller(net, ctrl)
    # 18 sibling pairs cross 1 switch, 54 cross-leaf pairs cross 3
    assert ctrl.install_all_rules({h.name: h.ip for h in net.hosts}) == 180
    assert ctrl.total_rules_installed() == 180
    assert ctrl.flow_tables["s1"].size() == 54
    assert ctrl.flow_tables["s2"].size() == 42
    assert abs(ctrl.total_install_time() - 18.0) < 1e-9


def test_link_failure_reroutes_affected_flows_only():
    net = Mininet(topo=RingTopo(k=4, n=1, bw=1000, delay=1.0))
    net.start()
    ctrl = ProactiveController("c0")
    attach_controller(net, ctrl)
    assert ctrl.install_all_rules({h.name: h.ip for h in net.hosts}) == 28
    # 6 of the 12 ordered host pairs are routed over s1-s2
    assert len(ctrl.affected_paths("s1", "s2")) == 6
    assert ctrl.handle_link_failure("s1", "s2") == 20
    assert ("s1", "s2") in ctrl.failed_links

def test_match_action_table_rules():
    t = P4MatchActionTable("ipv4_lpm", ["dst_ip"], max_size=3)
    assert t.size() == 0 and t.match_fields == ["dst_ip"]
    assert t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, "fwd", {"port": 1}) is not None
    assert t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}, "fwd", {"port": 2}) is not None
    assert t.size() == 2
    # re-adding the same match modifies rather than duplicates
    t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, "fwd", {"port": 9})
    assert t.size() == 2
    assert t.lookup({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}).action_params["port"] == 9
    assert t.lookup({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.9"}) is None
    # capacity is enforced
    t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.3"}, "fwd", {"port": 3})
    assert t.is_full()
    assert t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.4"}, "fwd", {"port": 4}) is None
    assert t.size() == 3
    assert t.delete_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}) is not None
    assert t.delete_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.2"}) is None
    assert t.size() == 2
    t.clear()

    t.add_rule({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}, "fwd", {"port": 2}, priority=10)
    assert t.lookup({"dst_ip": "10.0.0.1"}).priority == 10
    # the wildcard rule still catches everything else

    assert not parser.is_valid(b"\x00" * 8)
    assert parser.is_valid(b"\x00" * 9)
    assert parser.parse(b"\x00" * 8) == {}
    packet = bytes([10, 0, 0, 2]) + bytes([10, 0, 0, 1]) + b"\x06" + b"payload"
    headers = parser.parse(packet)
    assert headers["dst_ip"] == 0x0A000002
    assert headers["src_ip"] == 0x0A000001
    assert headers["proto"] == 6
    assert parser.payload(packet) == b"payload"
    assert deparser.deparse(headers, parser.payload(packet)) == packet
    # a rewritten field survives the round trip
    headers["dst_ip"] = 0x0A000009
    assert deparser.deparse(headers, b"")[:4] == bytes([10, 0, 0, 9])

    table = P4MatchActionTable("ipv4_lpm", ["dst_ip"])
    table.add_rule({"dst_ip": 0x0A000002}, "ipv4_forward", {"port": 7})
    sw.add_table(table)
    sw.add_counter(P4Counter("ingress", 8))
    assert sw.get_table("ipv4_lpm") is table
    assert sw.get_counter("ingress") is not None
    assert sw.get_table("nope") is None and sw.get_counter("nope") is None

    assert sw.packets_processed == 1

    assert d.startup_overhead_ratio == 50.0


def test_vnf_and_chain_arithmetic():
    vnf = VNF("fw", processing_delay_ms=1.0, overhead_pct=5.0)
    assert abs(vnf.throughput_factor - 0.95) < 1e-12
    chain = build_chain(3, processing_delay_ms=1.0, overhead_pct=5.0,
                        link_bw=1000, link_delay=0.5)
    assert isinstance(chain, ServiceFunctionChain) and chain.num_vnfs == 3
    # a 3-VNF chain has 4 links: client -> vnf1 -> vnf2 -> vnf3 -> server
    assert chain.num_links == 4
    assert abs(chain.compute_throughput() - 857.375) < 1e-9
    assert abs(chain.compute_latency() - 5.0) < 1e-12
    # an empty chain is a single link with no processing cost

    assert empty.compute_latency() == 0.5

    s1 = net.addSwitch("s1")

    assert abs(container_fairness(net.containers()) - 8.0 / 11.0) < 1e-12
    # an even split is perfectly fair, and fairness is scale invariant
    even = Containernet()
    for i in range(4):

    assert abs(even.compute_resource_fairness() - 1.0) < 1e-12

    # max_range inverts received_signal_strength
    d = max_range(20.0, -80.0, F24, 3.0, 1.0)
    assert abs(received_signal_strength(20.0, F24, d, 3.0, 1.0) + 80.0) < 1e-9
